preconditions.description: The dimensions of the chessboard are between 3 and 1000.
Alice's queen is within the bounds of the chessboard.
Bob's king is within the bounds of the chessboard.
Bob's target position is within the bounds of the chessboard.
Bob's king is not initially on the same square as Alice's queen.
Bob's target position is not the same as Alice's queen's position.
Bob's target position is not the same as Bob's king's initial position.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if can_reach_without_check(n, a_x, a_y, b_x, b_y, c_x, c_y) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: Bob can reach the target position without getting in check if and only if the output is 'YES'.
